content:
Sarah P.: Hey team — dropping the latest co-branded solution brief draft with OrbitCloud. Need a quick sign-off on logo treatment, color usage, and the partner attribution blurb. PDF: https://files.redwood/example/orbitcloud-sb-v3.pdf

Leo (Design): Looks good overall. Two quick design notes:
- Orbit logo is too close to the hero CTA (needs ~24px spacing).
- We can't put their wordmark on top of our gradient block — brand guideline no-no.
I can push a version with corrected spacing and a muted panel behind their mark.

Maria - Brand: +1 on Leo's points. Per Orbit brand: minimum 8px clearspace around logo, no color overlays, prefer PNG/SVG wordmark only (no stacked marks in hero). Also: use their primary blue (#0066CC) only for small accents, not backgrounds.

Devon S.: Sales asks for a one-sentence case highlight we can put in the one-pager intro: "Reduced inference latency by 35% and per-token cost by 40% in production." Is that safe to publish? We pulled those numbers from the pilot report.

Evan (Legal): Quick legal check — we need explicit partner approval for any performance claims. Two action items: 1) Remove customer name from the draft unless Orbit confirms permission, 2) change "reduced" to "observed up to" if we can't get signed confirmation. Once Orbit signs off, we can revert to concrete phrasing.

Sarah P.: Good call. I'll ask Orbit for: SVG of wordmark, confirmation of the performance numbers, and permission for the customer quote. Will request by EOD. @PartnershipsBot can you add a follow-up reminder in 48h?

PartnershipsBot: Reminder created: follow-up with OrbitCloud for logo + numbers — due in 48 hours.

Leo (Design): Uploaded quick mock with safer treatments: https://files.redwood/example/orbitcloud-sb-design-v2.png — switched hero to a neutral panel, moved logo, added a small partner badge row at bottom. Thoughts?

Maria - Brand: That mock is much closer. Two tiny edits: align partner badge baseline with the footer copy, and replace the placeholder "Partner" badge with Orbit's approved lockup (once we get their SVG).

Devon S.: Perfect. Also can we add a 1-line "what we delivered" bullet under the summary for the sales deck? Short, punchy: e.g., "High-throughput inference at predictable cost" — keeps it vendor-neutral.

Evan (Legal): Also add a short attribution line: "Joint solution developed by Redwood Inference and OrbitCloud" — legal-approved as long as Orbit's assets are used per their guidelines.

Sarah P.: Awesome — I'll consolidate changes and ping Orbit. If they approve the SVG + numbers within 48h we can finalize and publish next Tuesday. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Leo (Design): TY! :rocket:

Maria - Brand: :white_check_mark:

Evan (Legal): :ok_hand:

Devon S.: :thumbsup:
